entities.name: Camillus Archibong Etokudoh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Camillus Archibong Etokudoh, is a prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as the third
bishop of Port Harcourt from 2009 to 2025, following 20 years as bishop of Ikot Ekpene.
